7251670.name: Chabad of Lachine
7251670.note: COLlive, 8 Nov 2026 ('New Shluchim to Lachine, Montreal'): 'Rabbi Fully and Goldi Wilmowsky, together with their baby Fayga, have moved to Lachine, Montreal, Quebec to establish a new Chabad Center'; 'Since arriving ... We welcomed community members for Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur services, hosted Sukkos celebrations, and established weekly Shabbos services'; 'The last synagogue in Lachine closed its doors in 1944.' Its chabad.org listing went up 13 Apr 2026.

331810.name: Chabad of Chomedey & Laval
331810.note: No founding year found yet. COLlive, 3 July 2012 ('City Marks Rabbi's 25 Years'): Rabbi David Raphael Banon 'is marking 25 years since he has been appointed spiritual leader of Centre Communautaire Sepharade in Chomedey and subsequently Chabad Shliach of Chomedey', so the Chabad came after 1987; COLlive, 22 Oct 2009, calls the Centre Communautaire Sépharade de Chomedey 'a congregation founded in 1993'. Its chabad.org listing went up 2005-12-01, so it existed by then. Director: David Raphael Banon.

1013109.name: Chabad Centre for Jewish Life S. Lazare
1013109.note: The Hudson Gazette (Jim Duff) on COLlive, 3 Feb 2010 ('Can't Wait for the Rabbi'): 'With the arrival in December of the Chabad Jewish Community Centre on Côte St. Charles, that has changed'; 'Last Rosh Shoshanna [Rosh Hashanah, Sept 2009], Rabbi Labkowski held services at Auberge du Rigaud' for forty people. COLlive, 19 Jan 2010 ('New Shluchim to Quebec', https://collive.com/new-shluchim-to-quebec/): 'Two weeks ago, Rabbi Nochum and Malki Labkowski and their children ... have moved to the off-island suburb'. The year is their first services there (High Holidays 2009); its chabad.org listing went up 19 Oct 2009.

262675.name: Rabbinical College of Quebec
262675.note: COLlive, 10 Oct 2021 ('Farbrengen Marks 80 Years of Tomchei Tmimim Montreal'): 'The Farbrengen marked 80 years since the establishment of Yeshivas Tomchei Tmimim in Montreal in 5702' (the year from Sept 1941). COLlive, 15 June 2020: 'For 77 years, the Rabbinical College of Quebec has educated, elevated, and inspired the global Chabad community' ('Montreal Zal'), which counts back to about 1943. Medium: secondary sources two years apart; its chabad.org listing went up only in 2005.

1604353.name: Chabad South Shore / Rive-Sud
1604353.note: Chabad.org on COLlive, 12 Mar 2012 ('South Shore's Spiritual Revival'): Rabbi Zalman Samama 'and his wife, Sterna Sarah, moved to the area in October 2010 with their two children'; a resident 'hadn't seen anything recently until a few months ago, when Samama and his family bought a house in Brossard'. Medium: COLlive, 19 Sept 2012, says instead 'A year ago, Shluchim Zalman and Sterna Sarah Samama moved to Brossard'; its chabad.org listing went up 28 Aug 2011.

757095.name: Rohr Chabad of NDG
757095.note: The Canadian Jewish News (Janice Arnold) on COLlive, 7 Oct 2013 ('Chabad Takes Over Former Church'): during the High Holidays Chabad of NDG moved into a former church; 'The synagogue/community centre was located in trendy Monkland Village for five years, led by the charismatic young Rabbi Yisroel Bernath.' Medium: counted back; its chabad.org listing went up 28 Oct 2008, which agrees.
